rules.description: Applicant must be an employer with at least one employee
rules.reason_if_failed: You only need Employers' Liability insurance if you have employees

rules.description: Must employ someone other than close family members
rules.reason_if_failed: You do not need EL insurance if you only employ close family members (spouse, civil partner, parents, children, siblings, or step-family)

rules.description: Must have at least one employee based in England, Scotland or Wales
rules.reason_if_failed: You do not need EL insurance if all your employees are based outside England, Scotland and Wales

rules.description: Insurance must provide at least £5 million cover
rules.reason_if_failed: Your EL insurance must provide at least £5 million cover to meet legal requirements

rules.description: Insurance must be from an FCA-authorised insurer
rules.reason_if_failed: Your insurer must be authorised by the Financial Conduct Authority. Check the FCA register.

edge_cases.description: Employer operates from multiple workplace locations
edge_cases.action: Certificate must be displayed at each workplace location where employees work. Digital display on company intranet is acceptable if all employees can access it.

edge_cases.description: Business operates in high-risk sector (construction, manufacturing, etc.)
edge_cases.action: Higher premiums likely. Agent should recommend insurance broker for specialist advice. Route to BIBA broker search.

edge_cases.description: Business has ceased trading but had previous employees
edge_cases.action: Must maintain records of past EL insurance for at least 40 years. Contact insurer about run-off cover.

edge_cases.description: Sole director of limited company with no other employees
edge_cases.action: Company directors are not legally employees, but EL insurance is recommended. Check with professional advisor.
